openai-codex/gpt-6-astra.character: Advisory: Astra runs at xhigh wherever it is used in this profile: the advisor session, planner nodes, and wide-breadth child advisors. Regular bounded builders use Sol medium, including fully locked execution packets. This profile recommends Codex models only.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol.character: Advisory: The regular workhorse at medium reasoning for bounded implementation, fully locked execution packets, fresh-context checking, and reduction. For locked packets, it resolves environment and tooling obstacles locally, uses deterministic anchors, and stops and escalates on material ambiguity. Use Sol max for materially ambiguous or wide-breadth implementation.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna.character: Advisory: The scouting and browser-verification model at max reasoning. Use it for source-linked investigation, integrated browser exercise, and bounded evidence capture. Other semantic roles use Astra or Sol in this profile.
